nodes.title: Your karma balance is never a guess

Given an announcement has a cover image and a formatted body, When I open it from the Lab, Then I read the whole story with its cover, headings, emphasis and links rendered.
Given several backlog ideas have collected upvotes, When the backlog loads, Then the most-wanted ideas sit at the top, ties broken by the newest first.

Given my language is French and an entry has a French translation, When I read it in the Lab, Then I get the French title, summary and body, and English wherever the translation is missing.

Given a shipped entry carries a release date, When I read the changelog, Then that date leads the row and the list is ordered by it, newest first, with entries that have none falling back to when they were published.
Given I am on the Lab, When I tap the pinned community card, Then the WhatsApp invite opens so I can join the other people building Pebbles with the team.
Given one of the Lab's feeds fails to load, When I open the Lab, Then the sections that did load still render and the error screen only appears when nothing could be loaded at all.

Given an entry is tagged for one platform only, When I browse the Lab on a different platform, Then that entry is not in my feed and I only see what is tagged for the app I am using or for every platform.
Given the team has published Lab entries, When I open the Lab, Then I see announcements, what just shipped, what is in progress and what is on the backlog in one place.

nodes.title: RPC accept_connection_invite
nodes.description: Definer RPC that validates the token live, rejects self-accept, rejects a block in either direction as invite_expired, and inserts the ordered pair on conflict do nothing. nodes.title: RPC admin_attribute_glyph
nodes.description: Admin-gated. Reassigns a glyph's author, so a glyph uploaded by the back-office can be credited to the person who actually drew it.

nodes.title: GET /auth/callback (admin)
nodes.description: Back-office OAuth/magic-link callback. Exchanges the `code` query parameter for a session and redirects to /logs; a missing code or a failed exchange redirects back to /login with an error flag.

nodes.title: POST /auth/signout (admin)
nodes.description: Back-office sign-out. Clears the Supabase session and redirects to /login with a 303.

nodes.title: RPC admin_create_achievement
nodes.description: Admin-gated. Adds a new tier to an existing achievement family (slug, threshold, anchor, sort order, karma, bilingual copy). A new kind of rule is out of scope — the family CHECK is the boundary of what check_achievements() can evaluate.

nodes.title: RPC admin_delete_achievement
nodes.description: Admin-gated. Removes a badge from the catalog.

nodes.title: RPC admin_delete_glyph
nodes.description: Admin-gated. Deletes a glyph outright — the moderation escape hatch for something that should never have existed.

nodes.title: RPC admin_find_user
nodes.description: Admin-gated lookup of an account by email (case- and whitespace-insensitive), returning only its id and email. Used to pick the author a glyph should be attributed to.

nodes.title: RPC admin_list_achievements
nodes.description: Admin-gated. The full achievement catalog including inactive rows, with each badge's joined glyph geometry, emotion/domain slugs and unlock count, ordered by sort_order then slug.

nodes.title: RPC admin_list_domains
nodes.description: is_admin-gated SECURITY DEFINER RPC. Returns every domain (id, slug, name, label, default_glyph_id) left-joined to its glyph geometry (strokes, view_box), ordered by name. The admin Domains list + editor read path.

nodes.title: RPC admin_list_emotion_categories
nodes.description: is_admin-gated SECURITY DEFINER RPC. Returns every emotion_categories row with all palette columns (primary, secondary, light, surface, shaded, dark), ordered by name. The admin Emotions Palettes-tab read path.

nodes.title: RPC admin_list_emotions
nodes.description: is_admin-gated SECURITY DEFINER RPC. Returns every emotion joined to its category (id, slug, name, emoji, plus category id/slug/name/primary_color), ordered by category then emotion name. The admin Emotions Emojis-tab read path.

nodes.title: RPC admin_list_glyph_submissions
nodes.description: is_admin-gated SECURITY DEFINER RPC. Returns submissions joined to glyph geometry (strokes/view_box/name) + submitter email, ordered oldest-first. The moderation queue's read path — bypasses the RLS gap that hides pending submissions' strokes from admins.

nodes.title: RPC admin_set_achievement_glyph
nodes.description: Admin-gated. Points one badge at a glyph, so the achievement renders with the same geometry the apps draw.

nodes.title: RPC admin_set_domain_glyph
nodes.description: is_admin-gated SECURITY DEFINER RPC. Sets/replaces a domain's glyph in place: when default_glyph_id is null it inserts a system-owned (NULL user_id), shapeless glyph and links it; otherwise it overwrites that glyph row's strokes/view_box (same glyph_id — no orphans, and every consumer updates). Rejects empty strokes (empty_glyph) or unknown domain (not_found).

nodes.title: RPC admin_update_achievement
nodes.description: Admin-gated. Updates one badge's bilingual copy, karma reward, sort order and active flag. Karma changes apply to future unlocks only.

nodes.title: RPC admin_update_domain
nodes.description: is_admin-gated SECURITY DEFINER RPC. Updates a domain's name and label (description); trims input and rejects an empty name (bad_name) or unknown domain (not_found).

nodes.title: RPC admin_update_emotion_emoji
nodes.description: is_admin-gated SECURITY DEFINER RPC. Updates one emotion's emoji; trims input and rejects empty or >16-char values (bad_emoji) or an unknown emotion (not_found).

nodes.title: RPC admin_update_emotion_palette
nodes.description: is_admin-gated SECURITY DEFINER RPC. Updates a category's five palette variants (primary, secondary, light, shaded, dark) and re-derives surface_color from primary (RGB + 1A alpha, ~10%). Each colour must be 8-digit hex #RRGGBBAA (bad_color); unknown category raises not_found.

nodes.title: RPC approve_glyph
nodes.description: is_admin-gated SECURITY DEFINER RPC. Sets a pending submission to approved (live in Market), stamps reviewed_at/reviewed_by, with an optional price override.

nodes.title: GET /auth/callback
nodes.description: The only auth route handler this product owns. Any failure redirects to /login?error=auth_callback_failed.

nodes.title: get_kpi_daily
nodes.description: SECURITY DEFINER plpgsql RPC, gated on is_admin(auth.uid()). Takes p_range ('7d'|'30d'|'90d'|'1y'|'all'). Returns the latest row of v_analytics_kpi_daily plus the row at (latest - period_length) for delta computation, plus the trailing 30 days for sparklines.
