nodes.title: Achievements
nodes.description: Gallery of unlocked and upcoming achievements.

nodes.title: Admin · Achievement editor
nodes.description: Edit one badge's bilingual copy, karma reward, sort order, glyph and active flag, or delete it. Karma edits apply to future unlocks only — nobody is paid again or clawed back.

nodes.title: Admin · New achievement
nodes.description: Add a new tier to an existing achievement family: slug, threshold, emotion or domain anchor, sort order, karma reward and bilingual copy. Only the catalog is editable here; a new kind of rule still needs a migration and a new arm in check_achievements().

nodes.title: Admin · Achievements
nodes.description: The achievements library. Badges grouped by family in catalog sort_order (the order the apps render), filterable by family, each row showing its glyph and unlock count. Retired badges stay listed so the admin can see what was taken out of circulation.

nodes.title: Admin · Analytics
nodes.description: Back-office analytics page (admin-only). Thin slice (PR #337): KPI strip (Total users, DAU, WAU, MAU, Pebbles/day, DAU/MAU) + Active users line chart with DAU/WAU/MAU toggle. Global time-range tabs (7d/30d/90d/1y/All) URL-driven via ?range=. Layout extension (#339): Active users chart shrinks to 8/12 and a Retention cohort heatmap (last 8 weekly signup cohorts) fills 4/12. Five other buildable surfaces (volume, enrichment, per-user, domain share, visibility, single-emotion share) follow on the same milestone (M28).

nodes.title: Admin · Domain editor
nodes.description: Edit one life domain's name and description and set its glyph. Names and descriptions are also localized in the per-app catalogs, so edits here update the fallback copy.

nodes.title: Admin · Domains
nodes.description: Back-office domain management (#518). Admin-only. Lists every domain with its current glyph thumbnail; a per-domain editor edits name + description (the domains.label column) and uploads/replaces the domain's glyph. The glyph reuses the stroke-only SVG pipeline (svgToStrokes + scale/recenter/flip adjust baked into geometry) shared with the glyph uploader. Text edits update the DB fallback only — localized domain names/labels still come from the client i18n catalogs; the glyph is language-neutral and newly DB-sourced. All mutations go through is_admin-gated SECURITY DEFINER RPCs.

nodes.title: Admin · Emojis
nodes.description: Back-office emotion emoji editor (#608). Admin-only page at /emotions/emojis. Lists all emotions grouped by category, each with an inline emoji editor. Reads via admin_list_emotions; writes via the is_admin-gated admin_update_emotion_emoji RPC.

nodes.title: Admin · Not authorised
nodes.description: The 403 page. Reached when a signed-in account fails is_admin(). Offers a sign-out and a link back to the login page so the operator can switch accounts.

nodes.title: Admin · Glyph moderation
nodes.description: Back-office moderation queue for community glyph submissions (#497, M36 sub-project D). Admin-only. Status-filtered list (pending/approved/rejected) of submissions, each previewed as its shapeless square glyph. Approve (publishes to Market, optional price override), Reject (required reason stored in review_note, shown to the submitter), and Re-price approved listings. All mutations go through is_admin-gated SECURITY DEFINER RPCs; the queue reads via admin_list_glyph_submissions because the widened glyphs SELECT policy does not expose pending submissions' strokes to admins via RLS.

nodes.title: Admin · Upload glyph
nodes.description: Back-office authoring flow (#497, M36 sub-project D). Admin-only. Imports a raw SVG, parses it into the stroke-only glyph model (supported subset: path/line/polyline/polygon, commands M L H V Q C Z; fills/other elements skipped and reported), previews it as a shapeless square glyph, adjusts name/price plus scale/recenter/flip transforms (baked into geometry at publish), and publishes a first-party (admin-owned) community glyph via publish_admin_glyph.

nodes.title: Admin · Announcements
nodes.description: The announcements board: unpublished drafts above, published announcements below. Entry point for creating an announcement log.

nodes.title: Admin · Edit log
nodes.description: Edit one Lab log: same bilingual form as New log, plus publish/draft state, its release date, and deletion.

nodes.title: Admin · Features
nodes.description: The feature changelog board. Feature logs grouped In progress / Planned / Backlog / Shipped, filterable by platform, newest first (shipped sorts on released_at, the rest on updated_at). Entry point for creating a feature log.

nodes.title: Admin · New log
nodes.description: Compose a Lab log — bilingual title and summary, species, platform, status, release date, cover image. Pre-fills its species from the query string, and can prefill the whole form from a Lab Note YAML snippet on the clipboard.

nodes.title: Admin · Login
nodes.description: Back-office sign-in. Email + password against Supabase auth, then a redirect to /logs. Wrong credentials return a single generic error so the form never says whether the account exists.

nodes.title: Admin · Palettes
nodes.description: Back-office emotion palette editor (#608). Admin-only page at /emotions/palettes. Lists every emotion category with a live swatch preview and edits its five hand-tuned variants (primary, secondary, light, shaded, dark) via hex text inputs plus native colour pickers that preserve the alpha byte. surface_color is not edited — it is re-derived from primary (RGB + 1A ≈10%) server-side on every save. Reads via admin_list_emotion_categories; writes via the is_admin-gated admin_update_emotion_palette RPC.

nodes.title: Admin · Analytics playground
nodes.description: Internal harness that renders every analytics chart against dense, sparse and empty fixtures, so the empty and degenerate states can be checked without waiting for real data. Not in the sidebar — reachable only by URL.

nodes.title: Admin · Glyph playground
nodes.description: Internal harness for the SVG-to-strokes converter: fixed sample SVGs (lines, curves, polylines, unsupported shapes, exponent coordinates) rendered next to their stroke count and the elements the parser skipped. Not in the sidebar — reachable only by URL.

nodes.title: Announcement Detail
nodes.description: Announcement page: 200pt cover, display title, subtitle summary, and the body rendered through the V1 markdown subset (blank-line blocks, #/##/### headings as plain text, inline-only bold/italic/code/links/strikethrough — match, don't exceed). No toolbar title (iOS quirk, matched). Android (M44) renders it as a content swap inside the Lab route rather than a NavHost sub-route.

The `pebble_cards` / `card_types` tables and `computeKarmaDelta`'s card bonus still exist, so DM-card is deliberately left live — only the view is gone.

nodes.title: Attach Glyph

Android (M43 D, #587, closes #549): the picker is now the tabbed store surface inside the caller's sheet — inline buy and carve as content swaps (never stacked sheets); Mine keeps system glyphs (named deviation); the M39 API (currentGlyphId + onSelected) is unchanged at all three call sites.

nodes.title: Carve Glyph

nodes.title: Glyph Purchase Pill
nodes.description: Glanceable confirmation after a karma purchase: a bottom-center pill reading "Glyph unlocked" with the karma spent, using a stable id so a new purchase replaces the pill already up rather than stacking. nodes.title: Karma Earned Flash
nodes.description: Delight surface (M36, #505) shown when a user earns karma by creating or enriching a pebble. Renders an in-app "liquid glass" pastille that pops up bottom-center (real .glassEffect on iOS 26, translucent-material fallback below), hosted in a pass-through overlay window so it floats above the create/edit/detail sheets. Shows a sparkle + "+N karma" with an accent-color countdown ring that drains over its ~2.5s lifetime; tap to dismiss. Fires a Core-Haptics vibration matched to a ceramic sound (sound only in ringtone mode, never interrupting other audio). Works on every device and iOS 17+ — the Dynamic Island is deliberately NOT used, because iOS won't render a foreground app's own Live Activity and karma is always earned by a foreground action. The "+N" amount is the exact server-computed delta returned as karma_delta by the compose-pebble / compose-pebble-update edge functions (read back from karma_events); delight-only, never authoritative over the balance. Non-positive deltas (deletions/clawbacks) stay silent. The ActivityKit/PebblesWidget stack is retained, unused, as the reference for a future Glyph-purchase Live Activity. Android (M39 D9, #541): the analog pastille — Material tonal-elevation capsule + countdown ring overlaid in RootScreen's authed branch, one system CONFIRM haptic, no sound (named v1 reduction; ceramic sound + waveform haptic are deferred fast-follows).

platformNotes.android: `KarmaEarnedCapsule` hosted by `KarmaOverlayHost` in `RootScreen`, mirroring iOS 1:1 on the same server-computed `karma_delta`; `HapticFeedbackConstants.CONFIRM` fires per fresh content, and there is no sound.
platformNotes.ios: `KarmaEarnedCapsule` — a liquid-glass pastille on a pass-through overlay window so it floats above the create/edit sheets, with an accent countdown ring draining over ~2.5s, a Core Haptics waveform matched to the ceramic sound, and tap-to-dismiss. The amount is the server-computed `karma_delta` read back by the compose-pebble edge functions. The ActivityKit / Dynamic Island stack is retained in the target but never invoked: iOS will not render a foreground app's own Live Activity, and karma is always earned by a foreground action.
platformNotes.web: `KarmaActivityPill` fired by `notifyKarma` from the pebble mutation hooks on a positive karma delta; a bottom-center toast with a stable id so a fresh credit replaces the pill rather than stacking, tappable straight through to /wallet. No haptic, no sound (PWA limits).

nodes.title: Quick Pebble Editor
nodes.description: Single-page pebble creation editor (V2) combining all enrichment steps. On /path the editor is anchored to the bottom dock — collapsed as a 'What happened?' trigger that opens an overlay bottom-sheet on tap; on /record it auto-opens as the route's primary affordance. Android (M39, #541/#542): full-screen CreatePebbleScreen/EditPebbleScreen hosting the shared PebbleForm with modal bottom-sheet pickers — full-screen surfaces instead of a bottom-sheet dock (M39 design D5). M42 (#581): the shared Android form gains the Photo section — single-photo attach via the system photo picker (client-side compression to 1024px/420px JPEG renditions, upload with compensating deletes), existing-snap row with eager delete_pebble_media removal, and save gates while an upload is pending or failed. Resuming a draft hydrates the form from its jsonb payload, dropping souls/collections/glyphs the user no longer owns. Publishing runs the normal compose-pebble path once and deletes the draft row. iOS (M47, #641): a bottom-bar "Save as draft" action, a file-backed snapshot flushed on scene-phase change, and server-side glyph verification via can_use_glyph on resume. The karma pastille is deliberately suppressed here because the amount is already on screen. iOS still fires the karma sound and haptic; on Android that haptic rides on the pastille itself, so the flow model's own success buzz is what marks the moment; web renders the same beat through `PebbleFramed`'s animate-in and suppresses the karma pill the same way. nodes.title: Record Pebble Flow
nodes.description: Step-by-step composer (M58) and the default way to record a pebble on all three clients: iOS (#723), web (#732) and Android (#725). Eleven screens with one action each — photo, when, name, valence, emotion, domain, souls, collection, glyph, privacy/publish, success. The sequence does work a single form cannot: the photo's EXIF pre-fills the moment, and the valence chosen on step 3 orders the emotion categories on step 4. `F-record-pebble`'s single-screen composer stays reachable by long-pressing the + on the Path (iOS), long-pressing the New pebble entry (Android), or at `/record?composer=form` (web). Three per-surface deviations, all deliberate: web keeps the collection step multi-select because the web composer has always allowed several collections; web has no haptic on tap (the Vibration API is unsupported in Safari/iOS and inconsistent elsewhere), so the web flow is the quiet one, and browser Back walks the steps with one history entry per step reached; Android buzzes on every tap as iOS does and is now the only surface still on the nine-tile valence grid, so its valence step commits and advances on tap and carries no Continue button, where iOS (#728) and web (#729) both draw the valence step as a fan of nine real stones with a two-axis roll underneath, commit in place and advance on Continue. The nine-tile grid is not gone on web: the edit sheets behind the pebble detail, the edit screen and the quick composer still host it, because a sheet that commits and closes on pick cannot host a roll that changes the value at every detent.
